modeling.objective: Single-class anomaly detection with waveform and motion time series

extractor.roi: Official Body ROI from original public detector
extractor.preprocess_order: 320x180 frame -> Body crop -> DeepFlow at original crop size -> official standardization -> 96x96 DeepPhys input
extractor.motion_branch: Copy raw optical-flow statistics before official normalization; no low-motion threshold or per-clip feature Z-score

channels.name: waveform_detrended
channels.definition: Official cumulative integration and lambda=100 detrend, before bandpass

channels.name: waveform_filtered
channels.definition: Official 0.3-1.0Hz forward-backward bandpass output; offline batch signal

channels.name: motion_speed_mean
channels.definition: Spatial mean sqrt((u/W/dt)^2+(v/H/dt)^2), before any flow Z-score

channels.name: motion_speed_p90
channels.definition: Spatial 90th percentile of the same normalized flow speed

channels.name: pixel_change_rate
channels.definition: Mean absolute adjacent grayscale pixel difference /255/dt in the same ROI

time_alignment.raw_archive_fps: Native FPS and source timestamps retained
time_alignment.classifier_grid_status: Derive a shared time grid from archived channels; no assumption that native frames have equal actual dt
time_alignment.motion_pair_convention: u,v and pixel difference at t refer to frame[t] -> frame[t+1], same pairing used by released preprocessor
time_alignment.last_motion_sample: Invalid, mask explicitly; never silently treat zero flow padding as a real stop

retention.input_unit: Entire provided numbered short clip; record actual duration rather than assume exactly 60s
retention.implementation_requirement: Keep official preprocessing sequence; infer the final partial DeepPhys batch instead of dropping it. Validate equivalence on complete chunks before bulk run.

scaling.feature_scaler: Fit on selected normal training partition only; reuse fixed parameters for deployment

quality.training_selection: Review valid breathing-observable windows; retain flags for missing ROI/low visibility/recording failure; do not mix synthetic control folders into normal training

deployment_contract.requirement: Training feature examples and Raspberry Pi downstream inference must use the same time window and processing context. Archived full-clip waveforms are not automatically a causal live detector; changing preprocessing normalization requires new model inference.

dataset_scope.filename_rule: numeric basename .mp4 in the folder itself

tls_exception: Per-request public-host exception matching existing workstation proxy setup
channels_role: Initial extraction/storage candidates, not mandatory model inputs

face_observation_export.role: Separate observation/alert metadata, not a confirmed respiration-model channel
